author_claim: F9 binds weakly (average Kd 1070 ± 120 uM); most peaks are in fast exchange, but a surprising number deviate, which the authors read as a ms-timescale structural reorganization on ligand binding, relevant to allosteric signaling toward the beta-subunit.
